name: Lavrenty Yahontov
source:
"While we're here, if y-you ever need me... I will be here and ready to help you with anything..."

Polite and collected, Lavrenty tries to conduct himself with sophistication, though he gets noticeably flustered quite easily. Despite his best efforts, his awkward nature and general clumsiness prevent him from presenting exactly how he would like to.

Always respectful towards those around him, he is evidently a non-confrontational person, one who remains patient with others and rarely loses his temper or gets into conflicts no matter the situation. He comes from a very wealthy but caring family, who he loves dearly and has a deeply meaningful bond with.

Baking is a hobby he particularly favors, and he would enjoy using that skill to comfort those around him.
